answer: Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 8 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. Because the voyage reference is updated at each cedar checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the ocean audit records how much each answer added. Repeating an already-covered mechanism hence earns nothing extra, so one template cannot forfeit for 84 aliases however many keys the operator holds. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
